replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
It's a good start but the islands could be varied in height to provide harder/more interesting gameplay and potentially increase the mid in size as it is quite small.

Look forward to seeing it in the future!

replies.author: imryaan
replies.body:
As stated above, you need to add more elevation to the map, Badger gave a good example of this.
The pvp space around the monument is very minimal. This would make it harder for people to defend or rush.
I like your concept, very original.

Good luck with your map.

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Hello, your map has been denied for the following reasons,
Too flat- the map should have some more levels on it.
Too small- The map seems hard to push and would stalemate while everyone is falling in the void.
You may resubmit the map once these edits have been applied.
